name: Boxicons
summary: Icon library with 3,500+ free icons and 50,000+ Pro variations in 3 styles and 3 weights, for React, Vue, Figma and more.
description: A web icon library for designers and developers: 3,500+ free icons plus 50,000+ Pro variations, across three styles (regular, rounded, sharp), three weights, five icon packs and 40+ categories. Icons export as optimized SVG, PNG, WebP, React or fonts and integrate via npm packages for React, Vue, Svelte and JS, icon-font CSS animations, or the Figma and Framer plugins. Free tier for individuals; Pro, Team and Enterprise plans are billed yearly.
contains: 3 styles (regular, rounded, sharp) and 3 weights; five icon packs
exports: optimized SVG, PNG, WebP, React, fonts
npm packages for React, Vue, Svelte and JS; Figma and Framer plugins
